title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

Oversee capacity planning and hiring ramp-ups to meet client timelines. Partner with Delivery Leads to align on requirements and expectations. Strong expertise in high-volume sourcing, pipeline management, and onboarding. Experience with client-side hiring models and stakeholder management. title: Freight Desk Manager
description: Position Scope The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region. This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets. Responsibilities and Accountabilities Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding. Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers. Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency. Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards. Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments. Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes. Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency. Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs. Mandatory Requirements Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments. Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape, including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks. Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes. Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and\ "Control Tower\" operationalmodels. Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments. Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR). Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field. Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination. Desirable Requirements Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree. Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience. Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools. Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.G., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

You are someone who: Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must) Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus) Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it You bring strong CM fundamentals: High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills Ownership mindset over site and content performance Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals Experience working with CMS platforms You work well with others and think ahead: Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? title: Product Owner
description: Estamos em busca de um Product Owner Sênior para liderar a evolução de produtos digitais no segmento de saúde, com forte proximidade das rotinas médicas, jornadas de consulta, fluxos clínicos e necessidades reais dos médicos e times assistenciais. Esse profissional será responsável por atuar como elo entre negócio, tecnologia, usuários e stakeholders, garantindo que as decisões de produto gerem valor para a operação, melhorem a experiência dos profissionais de saúde e pacientes, e sustentem os objetivos estratégicos da organização. O perfil ideal combina sólida experiência em produto com capacidade de entender a dinâmica do ambiente de saúde, especialmente a lógica por trás de consultas médicas, documentação clínica, jornadas assistenciais, gargalos operacionais e usabilidade para o médico no dia a dia. Principais responsabilidades Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio e as necessidades dos usuários. Traduzir objetivos estratégicos em requisitos claros, épicos, histórias de usuário e critérios de aceitação. Atuar em parceria com stakeholders das áreas de saúde, operação, negócio, tecnologia, UX e dados. Entender e mapear fluxos ponta a ponta do ambiente de saúde, incluindo consultas, agendamentos, prontuários, documentação clínica e rotinas de apoio ao médico. Levantar necessidades diretamente com usuários, especialmente médicos, equipes clínicas e times operacionais. Identificar dores nas rotinas médicas e administrativas, transformando essas necessidades em oportunidades de produto. Priorizar funcionalidades com base em valor de negócio, impacto para o usuário, viabilidade técnica e urgência. Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, apoiando o time com direcionamento funcional e esclarecimento contínuo de requisitos. Garantir que o produto entregue eficiência operacional, boa usabilidade, adoção e resultados mensuráveis. Conduzir ou apoiar atividades de discovery, como entrevistas, análise de fluxos, validações e testes de hipótese. Trabalhar em conjunto com times de engenharia e design para construir soluções práticas e centradas no usuário. Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho do produto, métricas de uso, feedbacks e resultados operacionais. Promover a melhoria contínua dos produtos, equilibrando necessidades regulatórias, operacionais e de experiência do usuário. Atuar como principal referência da squad em decisões de escopo, priorização e direcionamento funcional. Requisitos obrigatórios Experiência comprovada como Product Owner, Product Owner Sênior ou função equivalente em produto. Vivência sólida em ambientes ágeis, com atuação junto a squads multidisciplinares. Experiência no segmento de saúde, healthtech, operações clínicas, sistemas médicos ou contextos correlatos. Forte compreensão de fluxos de saúde, especialmente relacionados a consultas médicas, rotina do médico, agendamentos, jornada do paciente e necessidades assistenciais. Capacidade de compreender o que o médico precisa em termos de sistema, processo e usabilidade, mesmo quando a demanda não vem totalmente estruturada. Experiência na escrita de histórias de usuário, definição de critérios de aceitação e gestão estruturada de backlog. Habilidade de relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders. Capacidade de conectar estratégia de negócio com execução de produto e entrega de tecnologia. Perfil analítico, com capacidade de usar dados, evidências e feedbacks para apoiar priorização e tomada de decisão. Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos, com múltiplos stakeholders e mudanças de prioridade. Requisitos desejáveis Experiência prévia com produtos relacionados a: prontuário eletrônico, agendamento de consultas, telemedicina, otimização de fluxo clínico, portais médicos, jornada do paciente, coordenação do cuidado, plataformas assistenciais. Familiaridade com requisitos regulatórios, privacidade e compliance no setor de saúde. Experiência com integrações entre sistemas de saúde e interoperabilidade. Vivência com médicos, clínicas, hospitais, centros diagnósticos ou operações assistenciais. Experiência com discovery e desenho de serviços em contexto de saúde. Conhecimento de métricas relacionadas à eficiência clínica, fluxo de atendimento, adoção e performance operacional. Competências esperadas Forte senso de dono sobre o produto Excelente capacidade de priorização Visão de negócio com foco no usuário Capacidade de lidar com ambiguidade e transformar demandas em backlog acionável Escuta ativa e boa facilitação Empatia com médicos, pacientes e equipes operacionais Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos Pensamento estruturado para solução de problemas Tomada de decisão orientada a valor e impacto Alto nível de autonomia e accountability O que esperamos de sucesso nessa posição O roadmap do produto reflita prioridades reais do negócio e da operação em saúde. Médicos e usuários clínicos percebam que o produto apoia, e não dificulta, a rotina do dia a dia. Os requisitos estejam claros o suficiente para permitir execução eficiente pelo time de tecnologia. As entregas gerem ganhos concretos de eficiência, qualidade operacional, adoção e experiência do usuário. A squad tenha clareza sobre prioridades, contexto e objetivos de negócio. Diferencial importante Buscamos alguém que não apenas conheça produto, mas que tenha sensibilidade para entender a lógica do ambiente médico, conseguindo traduzir necessidades assistenciais e operacionais em soluções digitais de alto valor.

O perfil ideal combina sólida experiência em produto com capacidade de entender a dinâmica do ambiente de saúde, especialmente a lógica por trás de consultas médicas, documentação clínica, jornadas assistenciais, gargalos operacionais e usabilidade para o médico no dia a dia. Principais responsabilidades Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio e as necessidades dos usuários. Traduzir objetivos estratégicos em requisitos claros, épicos, histórias de usuário e critérios de aceitação. Atuar em parceria com stakeholders das áreas de saúde, operação, negócio, tecnologia, UX e dados. Entender e mapear fluxos ponta a ponta do ambiente de saúde, incluindo consultas, agendamentos, prontuários, documentação clínica e rotinas de apoio ao médico. Levantar necessidades diretamente com usuários, especialmente médicos, equipes clínicas e times operacionais. Identificar dores nas rotinas médicas e administrativas, transformando essas necessidades em oportunidades de produto. Priorizar funcionalidades com base em valor de negócio, impacto para o usuário, viabilidade técnica e urgência. Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, apoiando o time com direcionamento funcional e esclarecimento contínuo de requisitos. Garantir que o produto entregue eficiência operacional, boa usabilidade, adoção e resultados mensuráveis. Conduzir ou apoiar atividades de discovery, como entrevistas, análise de fluxos, validações e testes de hipótese. Trabalhar em conjunto com times de engenharia e design para construir soluções práticas e centradas no usuário. Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho do produto, métricas de uso, feedbacks e resultados operacionais. Promover a melhoria contínua dos produtos, equilibrando necessidades regulatórias, operacionais e de experiência do usuário. Atuar como principal referência da squad em decisões de escopo, priorização e direcionamento funcional. Requisitos obrigatórios Experiência comprovada como Product Owner, Product Owner Sênior ou função equivalente em produto. Vivência sólida em ambientes ágeis, com atuação junto a squads multidisciplinares. Experiência no segmento de saúde, healthtech, operações clínicas, sistemas médicos ou contextos correlatos. Forte compreensão de fluxos de saúde, especialmente relacionados a consultas médicas, rotina do médico, agendamentos, jornada do paciente e necessidades assistenciais. Capacidade de compreender o que o médico precisa em termos de sistema, processo e usabilidade, mesmo quando a demanda não vem totalmente estruturada. Experiência na escrita de histórias de usuário, definição de critérios de aceitação e gestão estruturada de backlog. Habilidade de relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders. Capacidade de conectar estratégia de negócio com execução de produto e entrega de tecnologia. Perfil analítico, com capacidade de usar dados, evidências e feedbacks para apoiar priorização e tomada de decisão. Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos, com múltiplos stakeholders e mudanças de prioridade. Requisitos desejáveis Experiência prévia com produtos relacionados a: prontuário eletrônico, agendamento de consultas, telemedicina, otimização de fluxo clínico, portais médicos, jornada do paciente, coordenação do cuidado, plataformas assistenciais. Familiaridade com requisitos regulatórios, privacidade e compliance no setor de saúde. Experiência com integrações entre sistemas de saúde e interoperabilidade. Vivência com médicos, clínicas, hospitais, centros diagnósticos ou operações assistenciais. Experiência com discovery e desenho de serviços em contexto de saúde. Conhecimento de métricas relacionadas à eficiência clínica, fluxo de atendimento, adoção e performance operacional. Competências esperadas Forte senso de dono sobre o produto Excelente capacidade de priorização Visão de negócio com foco no usuário Capacidade de lidar com ambiguidade e transformar demandas em backlog acionável Escuta ativa e boa facilitação Empatia com médicos, pacientes e equipes operacionais Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos Pensamento estruturado para solução de problemas Tomada de decisão orientada a valor e impacto Alto nível de autonomia e accountability O que esperamos de sucesso nessa posição O roadmap do produto reflita prioridades reais do negócio e da operação em saúde. Médicos e usuários clínicos percebam que o produto apoia, e não dificulta, a rotina do dia a dia. Os requisitos estejam claros o suficiente para permitir execução eficiente pelo time de tecnologia. As entregas gerem ganhos concretos de eficiência, qualidade operacional, adoção e experiência do usuário. A squad tenha clareza sobre prioridades, contexto e objetivos de negócio. Diferencial importante Buscamos alguém que não apenas conheça produto, mas que tenha sensibilidade para entender a lógica do ambiente médico, conseguindo traduzir necessidades assistenciais e operacionais em soluções digitais de alto valor.

title: Analista De Infraestrutura Azure Sr - Remoto
description:
A Foursys é apaixonada por inovação, design e transformação digital. Somos globais. Somos GPTW. E somos movidos por pessoas. ♿ Na Foursys, acreditamos que diversidade é potência. Valorizamos diferentes histórias, ideias e perspectivas — aqui, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras. São parte do que nos fortalece. Quer fazer parte do time e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent ? Então olha essa oportunidade Arquiteto(a) de Infraestrutura Sobre a oportunidade: Atividades: - Arquitetura Azure: Desenhar e sustentar soluções utilizando o framework de boa arquitetura da MS.
- Orquestração de Containers: Administrar e otimizar clusters AKS garantindo a saúde, monitoramento e o ciclo de vida das aplicações.
- Modernização: Liderar a transição de workloads legados (On-premises/VMs) para arquiteturas modernas (PaaS, IaaS, SaaS e Containers).
- Automação e DevOps: Evoluir as rotinas de automação para uma cultura de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC), utilizando Terraform ou Bicep.
- Identidade e Segurança: Conhecimento em B2C, EntraID garantindo políticas de acesso seguro (Conditional Access, RBAC).
- Gestão de Performance: Monitorar proativamente a saúde do ambiente Azure (Azure Monitor/Log Analytics/App Insights) Diferencial desejado: - Conhecimento em estratégias de migração (Cloud Adoption Framework).
- Experiência com ferramentas de CI/CD (Azure DevOps).
- Certificações: AZ-104 (Administrador) e AZ-900 (Fundamentos).
- Grande Diferencial: Certificação AZ-305 (Architect Design) e AZ-700 (Networking). Qualidade pessoais desejadas: - Capacidade analítica: Lidar com grandes volumes de dados exige identificar padrões, tendências e anomalias.Extrair insights de informações complexas é indispensável.
- Atenção aos detalhes: Pequenas variações nos dados podem indicar problemas sérios. É necessário ser meticuloso e preciso na análise de informações.
- Habilidade de resolução de problemas: - Identificar a raiz de problemas e desenvolver soluções é essencial.
- Pensar de forma lógica e sistemática para resolver desafios complexos.
- Comunicação eficaz: Comunicar informações técnicas de forma clara é vital para colaborar com equipes diversas. Explicar conceitos complexos de forma compreensível para diferentes públicos.
- Proatividade: Antecipar problemas e tomar medidas preventivas.
- Identificar áreas de melhoria e implementar soluções proativamente.
- Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão: Incidentes críticos exigem respostas rápidas e eficazes. Manter a calma e tomar decisões assertivas em situações de alta pressão.
- Aprendizado contínuo: A tecnologia evolui constantemente, exigindo aprendizado de novas ferramentas e técnicas. Curiosidade e desejo de se manter atualizado.
- Trabalho em equipe: Colaborar, compartilhar informações e auxiliar colegas é essencial para alcançar objetivos. Experiência anterior desejada: - Experiência: Mínimo de 10 anos em infraestrutura de TI, com vivência comprovada em ambientes robustos e missões críticas.
- Domínio Microsoft: Sólido conhecimento em AKS, ferramentas dos ambientes IaaS, PaaS e SaaS.
- Cloud: Experiência prática em administração de recursos Azure (Networking, App Services e Storage).
- Automação: Expertise em Azure CLI, Terraform para automação de processos e gestão de configurações.
- Resiliência: Experiência em planos de Disaster Recovery (DR) e atuação em crises com elaboração de laudos de causa raiz (RCA). Habilidades Técnicas: - Azure - AKS - AZ-104 - AZ-900 - estratégias de migração - IaC - Terraform - Bicep - On-premises - SaaS - Containers - PaaS Modelo de Trabalho: 100% Remoto Benefícios | Clube da Four

title: Product Owner
description: Product Owner - Sênior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? No seu dia a dia, você gerenciará o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Atuará como principal interlocutor entre as áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório, supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis. Você liderará cerimônias ágeis e garantirá a entrega contínua de valor, promovendo melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás. Além disso, acompanhará métricas de desempenho do produto (KPIs de negócio e de uso), proporá evoluções baseadas em dados e feedback dos usuários, e garantirá que as soluções desenvolvidas estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança e regulação do setor de gás. Como será seu dia a dia? Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Atuar como principal interlocutor(a) entre áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório e supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis. Liderar cerimônias ágeis e garantir a entrega contínua de valor para o produto. Promover melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás. Acompanhar métricas de desempenho (KPIs de negócio e de uso), analisando dados para direcionar evoluções do produto. Propor melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks dos usuários. Garantir que as soluções estejam em conformidade com normas de segurança e regulação do setor. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Visão holística e estratégica, com capacidade de compreender o negócio de distribuição de gás de ponta a ponta, conectando iniciativas de tecnologia às metas do negócio. Perfil de liderança com forte viés de execução, sendo “mão na massa”, orientado(a) a resultados e capaz de remover impedimentos para garantir entregas com qualidade e agilidade. Excelente comunicação e habilidade de transitar entre áreas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia. Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de produto (roadmaps, OKRs, MVPs). Experiência na liderança de squads multidisciplinares e atuação em ciclos de discovery e delivery. Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas. Você pode se destacar se: Possuir pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Negócios, Energia ou Transformação Digital. Tiver certificações em Product Ownership (CSPO, PSPO) e metodologias ágeis (CSM, SAFe). Tiver familiaridade com o setor de gás e energia, incluindo regulação da ANP e processos como medição, faturamento, logística e segurança operacional. Demonstrar forte visão sistêmica e pensamento crítico. Apresentar habilidade de negociação e influência. Ser resiliente e adaptável em ambientes de alta complexidade. Ter perfil colaborativo e facilitador. Demonstrar orientação a resultados e senso de urgência. Possuir experiência em contextos dinâmicos. Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Senior/Staff Platform Software Engineer
description: We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior/Staff Platform Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience to join our U.S. client. title: Accounting Manager
description: About UsEstablished in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.Key Responsibilities- Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.- Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.- Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.- Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.- Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.- Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.- Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.- Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm’s balance sheet.Requirements- Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.- Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.- Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.- Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.G., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.- Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.- Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

title: Llm Scientist
description: We are looking for an\ "LLM Scientist\" for our client, an international AI development company based in New York, who will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, enhancing the quality of data and the efficiency of data pipelines, and contribute to a team culture that values mentorship and knowledge sharing.Key ResponsibilitiesDesign and execute experiments by conducting ablation studies on various prompt strategies, tokenization methods, and fine-tuning hyperparameters.Own model decisions regarding the selection of foundation models for specific tasks and the acceptable trade-offs between latency and accuracy.Architect data pipelines in collaboration with Data Engineers to curate high-quality synthetic data and improve model training efficiency.Solve complex 'hallucination' problems by serving as the final escalation point for enhancing model factuality and designing logic for retrievers and re-rankers.Mentor the team by translating the latest research papers into actionable engineering tickets.Qualification RequiredExtensive experience with PyTorch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, Accelerate).Proven track record of fine-tuning models, with a deep understanding of attention mechanisms, positional embeddings, and transformer architectures.Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and familiarity with the mathematics behind similarity search and embedding models.Proficiency in Python, along with familiarity in containerization (Docker) and cloud-scale Al training (AWS SageMaker/GCP Vertex Al).Ability to analyze model failures, hypothesize root causes, and systematically test solutions.Nice to HaveAdvanced Degree: A Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Math, or a related field with a focus on NLP.Multi-Modal Experience: Familiarity with Vision-Language Models (VLM) or audio-to-text integration.Reinforcement Learning: Experience with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) or DPO (Direct Preference Optimization).Open Source Presence: A portfolio of public GitHub repos, Hugging Face models, or published papers in the GenAl space.Hardware Knowledge: Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100/A100) and CUDA kernels to maximize hardware utilization.About Our ClientOur client is a people-focused organization dedicated to developing impactful products and services that create meaningful value for customers and communities. They foster a collaborative, respectful, and inclusive work environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow professionally. The company supports flexibility and work–life balance while maintaining strong performance and accountability standards.Benefits & WellbeingCompensation for this role is determined based on competitive market data and may vary depending on geographic location, experience, skills, and qualifications. Specific details will be discussed during the interview process.The company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees' well-being, financial security, and professional development. Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plan contributions, paid time off, flexible working arrangements, and opportunities for career growth, in accordance with company policies and applicable local regulations. It is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country of employment.

title: Tech Agile Sênior
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:Atuar como facilitador e agente de transformação ágil, promovendo a cultura de melhoria contínua e fortalecendo a colaboração entre os times. Seu papel será apoiar equipes multifuncionais na adoção e maturidade de práticas ágeis, além de impulsionar a eficiência dos processos e o alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da organização.O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:- Capacitar e treinar pessoas em ferramentas, métodos e processos ágeis, promovendo o conhecimento contínuo e a autonomia dos times;
- Atuar como agente de mudança, questionando e provocando reflexões que fomentem o crescimento coletivo;
- Praticar escuta ativa,acolhendo e auxiliando nas questões individuais dos membros do time;
- Apoiar as squads na construção de senso de pertencimento e na busca por alta performance;
- Implementar práticas eferramentas ágeis de acordo com o contexto e maturidade dos times;
- Facilitar cerimônias ágeis, workshops de ideação, resolução de problemas e retrospectivas;
- Gerenciar métricas relacionadas à eficiência dos processos e à saúde cultural dos times;
- Estruturar processos de rotina e gestão do conhecimento para garantir a fluidez do trabalho;
- Ajudar os times na construção e condução de processos de experimentação e validação de hipóteses;
- Identificar pontos demelhoria e gargalos no dia a dia das squads, atuando de forma colaborativa para solucioná-los;
- Apoiar a estruturaçãoe reorganização de tribos, promovendo sinergia entre as equipes;
- Remover impedimentos egarantir que os times tenham um ambiente propício à entrega de valor.O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:- Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Lean, XP);
- Conhecimento em OKRs epráticas de gestão como Management 3.0;
- Técnicas de facilitação e dinâmicas colaborativas;
- Experiência em mapeamento, análise e melhoria de processos;
- Familiaridade com ferramentas de acompanhamento ágil (Jira, Confluence, Miro, etc.);
- Habilidade para atuarcom métricas de performance e cultura de times.Requisitos desejáveis:- Certificações em metodologias ágeis (CSM, PSM, KMP, ICP-ATF, etc.);
- Experiência como AgileCoach ou em ambientes com múltiplas squads;
- Vivência com escalabilidade ágil (SAFe, LeSS, Spotify model);
- Experiência em contextos de transformação digital e/ou cultural;
- Conhecimento em cultura DevOps e Design Thinking.- Desejável atuação com diferentes perfis de equipes (tecnologia, produto, negócios) e em iniciativas de mudança cultural ou estrutural.INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAISAntes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.Dito isso, oferecemos:● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;

title: Gerente De Operações Financeiras (Financial Operations Manager)
description:
Responsibilities: Manage daily financial operations, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow tracking, and crypto/stablecoin fund movements. Liaise with accounting firms for bookkeeping, document preparation, SPED filings, and tax submissions (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ISS). Maintain detailed records of all virtual asset activities to ensure compliance with internal audit and legal standards. Collect and organize data for regulatory reporting to Receita Federal and the Central Bank of Brazil. Monitor tax and foreign exchange compliance risks related to stablecoin-based transactions, and escalate issues as needed. Handle foreign exchange filings and reports for cross-border crypto transactions (e.G., RDE-IED, SISCOSERV). Assist in interpreting local regulatory developments and aligning operational processes accordingly. Provide financial and operational insights to support management in budgeting and strategic planning. Support internal reporting, KPI tracking, and process documentation. Effectively utilize financial operations software, crypto custody tools, and dashboards. Requirements: 3+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, or crypto-related back-office roles, preferably in fintech or Web3 environments. Solid understanding of stablecoins, blockchain-based payment flows, and operational risk. Familiarity with Brazilian financial reporting (SPED, Receita Federal, Central Bank) and tax compliance. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail. Fluency in Portuguese and English;
proficiency in Spanishand Mandarin is a plus. What we offer: Competitive salary and benefits. Opportunities for professional growth and development. A collaborative and innovative work environment. The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry. Preferred Qualifications: proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus Job type: Full Time Responsabilidades: Gerenciar as operações financeiras diárias, incluindo contas a pagar/receber, acompanhamento de fluxo de caixa e movimentações de fundos em cripto/stablecoins. Coordenar junto às empresas de contabilidade a escrituração, preparação de documentos, arquivos SPED e submissões fiscais (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ISS). Manter registros detalhados de todas as atividades de ativos virtuais para garantir a conformidade com auditorias internas e padrões legais. Coletar e organizar dados para relatórios regulatórios à Receita Federal e ao Banco Central do Brasil. Monitorar riscos de conformidade fiscal e cambial relacionados a transações com stablecoins e escalar problemas conforme necessário. Gerenciar registros cambiais e relatórios para transações transfronteiriças de criptomoedas (ex: RDE-IED, SISCOSERV). Auxiliar na interpretação de novas regulações locais e alinhar os processos operacionais de acordo. Fornecer insights financeiros e operacionais para apoiar a gestão na elaboração de orçamentos e planejamento estratégico. Apoiar relatórios internos, rastreamento de KPIs e documentação de processos. Utilizar efetivamente softwares de operações financeiras, ferramentas de custódia de cripto e dashboards. Requisitos: Mais de 3 anos de experiência em operações, operações financeiras ou funções de back-office relacionadas a cripto, preferencialmente em ambientes de fintech ou Web3. Sólida compreensão de stablecoins, fluxos de pagamento baseados em blockchain e risco operacional. Familiaridade com relatórios financeiros brasileiros (SPED, Receita Federal, Banco Central) e conformidade fiscal (tax compliance ). Fortes habilidades organizacionais e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas com atenção aos detalhes. Fluência em Português e Inglês;
proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial. O que oferecemos: Salário e benefícios competitivos. Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional. Um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inovador. A chance de trabalhar com tecnologia blockchain de ponta e causar um impacto significativo na indústria.

title: Senior Helpdesk Support Specialist
description: Position OverviewAs a senior member of our IT support team, you will provide advanced, second-level technical assistance to end-users, resolving complex issues related to computer hardware, software, and systems within a Windows-based environment. Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues by installing, modifying, and repairing computer software, and peripherals on Windows operating systems. Perform basic network triage for Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless access points to resolve initial connectivity issues before escalation. Execute fundamental administrative tasks in Active Directory, such as account unlocks and password resets, and provide end-user troubleshooting for Microsoft 365 applications. Utilize Microsoft Intune for key device management functions. Administer the IT asset management system, ensuring accurate tracking and documentation of software assets. Develop, preserve, and grow a comprehensive knowledge base of procedures and solutions for both internal help desk use and end-user self-help resources. Strong documentation discipline and ability to follow and improve SOPs and knowledge base articles Design and conduct training sessions for computer users to enhance their technical proficiency and understanding of IT systems. Manage and progress tickets in Jira Service Management, including triage, updates, proper routing, and escalation. Basic familiarity with endpoint security and antivirus concepts is helpful, issues are typically escalated to the appropriate security team. Required Skills & ExperienceProven experience providing remote help desk and desktop support, including diagnosing, guiding, and resolving issues related to computer hardware, software, and peripherals through virtual and phone-based assistance. Demonstrated leadership abilities, including experience providing technical guidance, coaching, and mentoring to junior help desk technicians. Working knowledge of help desk software and remote control tools. Experience working in Jira Service Management, or strong experience with similar ITSM ticketing systems and workflows. Experience with basic Active Directory user management, such as password changes and account unlocks, and providing end-user troubleshooting for Microsoft 365. Proficiency in resolving basic connectivity issues for Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless access points through basic triage. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to develop training materials and maintain a knowledge base. Proven ability to manage small IT projects and perform asset management administration. Familiarity with Microsoft Intune for device enrollment. Nice to Have SkillsProfessional IT certifications, such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or Microsoft IT Support. Familiarity with Microsoft Intune for device enrollment via Windows Autopilot and performing machine resets. Experience with PowerShell scripting to automate routine administrative tasks. Knowledge of supporting additional operating systems, such as macOS, iOS, or Android. Experience with advanced network troubleshooting using command-line tools. Soft SkillsDemonstrated leadership capabilities, with a focus on coaching, mentoring, and providing technical guidance to junior team members to foster their growth and ensure overall team success. Exceptional communication skills (verbal, written, and presentation), with the ability to convey complex technical solutions clearly to clients of varying proficiency levels and to conduct effective training sessions. Advanced analytical and troubleshooting abilities, characterized by a proactive approach to not only resolve immediate issues but also to identify root causes and implement solutions that prevent future occurrences. A strong client-centric mindset, demonstrating the ability to understand problems from the user's perspective and guide them through the resolution process with patience and clarity. Proven ability to work effectively within a high-performing team environment, collaborating with colleagues and assisting other IT support teams to share knowledge and achieve common goals. Excellent organizational and multitasking skills, including the ability to manage small IT projects, maintain meticulous attention to detail, and exercise sound judgment in tracking, routing, and escalating support tickets. Your skills will be honed, and your contributions will play a vital role in our continued success. Lean Tech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusiveenvironment for all employees.

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description: About RateGain RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day. Exploring the role RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business. The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond. This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations. How your day will look like/Job responsibility Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.G. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs) Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends Education & Work Experience Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships Knowledge: In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors Skills: Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.) Attitude: Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment Equal Opportunity Employer We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.
