title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description: About RateGain RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day. Exploring the role RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business. The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond. This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations. How your day will look like/Job responsibility Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.G. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs) Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends Education & Work Experience Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships Knowledge: In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors Skills: Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.) Attitude: Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment Equal Opportunity Employer We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
description: About the Job As Silicon Valley Consulting we help companies improve their ads by building custom martech solutions. You'll be working for Silicon Valley Consulting's child company TGA Fund. ( TGA Fund is a high-ownership venture builder studio that invests in startups and creates new startups in-house. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineering Manager to join our team! This is not a generic engineering management role. We need an engineer, first who is a hands on platform leader, reliable and decisive, with great communication skills. This is a high-ownership role where you’ll lead critical platform initiatives, scale high-performing teams, and shape the technical foundations of upcoming projects/products. You'll get to manage multiple SaaS products via the engineering team that you'll lead. You also get revenue share from the products you'll manage via the engineering team. You Will: Be in charge of the given quarterly budget, dictating how many engineering contractors that you can/want to have on the team. Interview engineering candidates. Code during crunch times. What You’ll Bring: (Preferred qualifications) Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience. Proficiency with backend service technologies (e. g., Java, Go, Javascript), RESTful API development, and modern engineering best practices. Experience with data systems (SQL/NoSQL), messaging technologies (e. g., Kafka), containerized environments (e. g., Kubernetes) and UI technologies. Familiarity with AI/ML ecosystems, including large language models, agentic AI, or AI productivity tools. Typically 4+ years of engineering experience with at least 1 years leading multiple teams and senior level engineering talent Solid understanding of system design, architecture principles, UI frameworks, and API driven ecosystems. Experience building or contributing to largescale marketplace or platform products. Strong problem solving abilities and familiarity with SDLC, CI/CD, observability, and production operations. Ability to partner across teamsand operate effectively in dynamic or ambiguous situations. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Commitment to fostering a healthy, inclusive team culture focused on quality, accountability, and continuous learning. If we like you, you'll be given a 90-day trial period. Please do not forget that this is a part-time role. Base pay during trial period: $280 USD to $500 USD per month (part-time) Benefits: Bonuses come from Revenue Sharing + Profit Sharing We also give you the opportunity to bring in your own ideas. If you have a project you want to realize, and believe it can benefit from our support, then you can always ask for a vote. If your idea passes the vote, we will partner with your dream and scale it with you. Why Us? We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. SVC and TGA Fund invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our organizations. We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status. Application: Please fill out the Google Form below in order to apply: Tip: Please take your time and answer these questions thoroughly. We know that many companies make you take pre-assesments and never read them. We actually do! We care about this role and if your responses are good you are guaranteed an interview. Don't use AI to answer any of these. If you're an actual (senior) engineer manager, you'll know how frustrating it is to read 500 responses that all sound the same.

description: Lead Developer — Llama Naturals (Remote) We are hiring a lead developer to own and grow our internal platform. Llama Naturals is a growing consumer brand. e produtos digitais, TotalPass e Queima Diária. Principais responsabilidades: 1. Estratégia de Testes: Definir a política de cobertura de testes e garantir que o time utilize mocks e ferramentas como VCR para manter a agilidade no desenvolvimento. 3. Sustentação, Suporte e Performance Atendimento de Chamados Nível 3: Atuar como ponto focal em problemas complexos de produção, realizando a análise de causa raiz e orientando o time na correção definitiva. Otimização Contínua: Monitorar gargalos de performance no servidor e no banco de dados, implementando melhorias proativas para suportar o crescimento do app. 4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua Radar Tecnológico: Manter o time atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, avaliando quando migrar ou adotar novas práticas. Cultura de Inovação Pragmática: Estimular o uso de ferramentas de IA para ganho de produtividade, sem abrir mão da segurança e da qualidade do código. O que buscamos Pessoas que: Dominem Arquitetura de Sistemas com Ruby on Rails: Domínio profundo de Rails em modo API e Monolitos, com habilidade para desenhar arquiteturas escaláveis, modulares e de fácil manutenção. Têm experiência com Modelagem e Performance de Dados: Maestria em PostgreSQL, otimização de queries, gestão de índices e estratégias de cache (Redis) para suportar aplicações de alta performance. Têm experiência com Segurança e Infraestrutura: Conhecimento sólido em protocolos de segurança (OAuth2, JWT), além de familiaridade com Docker e ambientes de deploy (AWS/Heroku/DigitalOcean). title: Back End Developer
description:
About EverUp We’re a UK startup making gift-card shopping rewarding. Our mobile app (React Native) and web (React) run on a serverless AWS backend. We’re hiring a Backend Cloud Engineer to evolve and maintain the APIs, databases, and services that power payments, wallet, rewards, and near-real-time features. The role You’ll work across our event-driven, serverless stack to maintain and evolve production systems. That means adding features, fixing bugs, improving performance and cost, tightening security, and raising reliability—while collaborating closely with Mobile/Web. What you’ll do Maintain and evolve AWS Lambda microservices behind Amazon API Gateway (HTTP/REST & WebSocket) and AWS IoT Core ;
implement authentication/authorization via Cognito User Pools (JWT) and Lambda authorizers for REST/HTTP. Maintain and optimize data models and access patterns in DynamoDB and MySQL (RDS);
handle indexes, migrations, and query performance. Maintain asynchronous workflows using SQS/SNS (idempotency, DLQs, retries) and keep observability healthy with CloudWatch metrics/logs and alarms. Maintain and improve our IaC (AWS SAM/CloudFormation), CI/CD pipelines, and environment promotions. Integrate and support third-party services used for payments, open banking, notifications, fraud/risk, analytics and support tooling. Troubleshoot production issues, drive RCAs, and implement preventive fixes and runbooks. Uphold security best practices (least-privilege IAM, secret management, input validation, auditability). Tech you’ll touch AWS Lambda, API Gateway (REST/WebSocket), Cognito, DynamoDB, RDS MySQL, SQS/SNS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudFormation/SAM, EC2, ECS, plus fintech/comms integrations (Open Banking/PSP, Gift Cards, Analytics, Messaging, Support, and Risk assessment tools). Must-haves 8+ years building/maintaining production backends;
4+ years with AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB). Proficiency in JavaScript/Node.Js;
strong REST API fundamentals and event-driven patterns. Solid SQL/NoSQL skills (schema design, indexing, query tuning). Experience maintaining IaC (SAM/CloudFormation) and CI/CD (Code Pipeline). Security-first mindset and practical debugging/troubleshooting chops (OWASP). WebSocket/API Gateway connection management and real-time features. Payments/fintech and fraud/risk integrations. Observability practices (dashboards, tracing, log correlation) and SLOs. Elastic Beanstalk familiarity and data pipelines/warehousing exposure. How we work Remote-first within UK time zone, startup-paced, with high ownership. We value clean code, small safe changes, and excellent operability. Hiring process Intro call Technical deep-dive (systems design discussions focused on maintainability and evolution) Practical walkthrough (IaC/API/data-modeling maintenance scenario) Founder/lead chat & references Equal opportunity We’re an equal-opportunity employer and welcome every background and perspective. How to apply Send your CV, GitHub/portfolio, and a brief note describing a production backend you maintained/evolved and the reliability or cost improvements you delivered.

title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration. Key Responsibilities Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation) Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes. Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes. Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations. Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools. Automation, Integration & AI Implementation Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.G., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript). Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks. Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software. IT Administration & Security Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365). Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl. Required Qualifications & Skills Technical Experience: 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.G., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols. Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies: Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving;
ability to identify theroot causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution;
capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions. Benefits & Compensation Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description: Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship. We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets. Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region. What You'll Gain: Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including: 3-Statement Financial Modeling Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis Trading Comparables (Comps) Precedent Transactions Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with: Pitch Book Development Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs) Financial Modeling Sourcing & Due Diligence Industry and Company Research And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals. Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing. This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals. Who We're Looking For: This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment. How to Apply: Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase. This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Desenvolvedor Servicenow | Especialista Técnico De Aplicações
description: Descrição da Vaga (JD): O desenvolvedor ServiceNow fará parte de uma equipe já estabelecida, apoiando a implementação do módulo Application Portfolio Management (APM) do ServiceNow. O profissional será responsável por ativar e configurar o módulo, além de trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times funcionais para definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema. Como Especialista Técnico de Aplicações, você poderá esperar: Formular e definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema. Ser responsável pelo design do programa, codificação, testes, depuração e documentação. Ter conhecimento técnico e responsabilidade por todas as fases de análise e programação de sistemas de aplicações. Compreender o negócio ou a função para a qual a aplicação está sendo projetada. Aprender continuamente sobre novas tecnologias, gerar novas ideias e melhorar o uso de tecnologias modernas em todo o portfólio de aplicações. Configurar e ativar o Application Portfolio Management (APM). Desenvolver relacionamentos de Itens de Configuração (CIs) para Capacidades de Negócio, Objetos de Informação, Aplicações de Negócio e Serviços de Aplicação. Integrar o APM com outros módulos do ServiceNow, incluindo ITSM e SAM. Utilizar fortes competências técnicas e expertise para identificar, analisar e solucionar problemas em produção, mantendo procedimentos que atendam às expectativas dos usuários de negócio. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais e times de desenvolvimento para entender e fornecer soluções/correções automatizadas. Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de Delivery e Suporte, bem como para a maturidade dos diferentes portfólios, capacidades, especializações e melhores práticas, considerando as necessidades e requisitos dos usuários e stakeholders. Participar de eventos SCRUM e concluir os itens atribuídos dentro da meta definida para a Sprint. Reunir-se com stakeholders-chave e acompanhar os itens de ação para quaisquer soluções alternativas necessárias, de acordo com a natureza dos requisitos. Qualificações e Requisitos Qualificações essenciais - Graduação ou Mestrado em Computação, Eletrônica ou área relacionada - Certificação ServiceNow System Administrator (CSA) - Certificação ServiceNow Certified Application Portfolio Management (APM) Implementer - Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de comunicar informações técnicas para públicos não técnicos Competências-chave 8 a 10 anos de experiência total na área de TI Conhecimento intermediário em linguagens de desenvolvimento: XML, HTML, CSS, Java e JavaScript Experiência na plataforma ServiceNow como Administrador e Desenvolvedor Experiência no desenvolvimento de Service Catalogs, implementação de ACLs, transform maps, Flows via Flow Designer, client scripts e métricas de saúde da CMDB Configuração de Assessments, Demands, Business Capability Maps e Information Objects Mais de 5 anos de experiência em administração ServiceNow nas seguintes áreas: Service Catalog, CMDB & Discovery, Service Portal, Workflows, Dashboards, REST APIs Experiência prévia com o módulo APM é desejável Outras habilidades e competências Capacidade de adaptação rápida para aprender novas ferramentas, novas tecnologias e padrões atuais do mercado Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente global e distribuído, sem supervisão Perfil autodirigido, proativo e com pensamento sistêmico

title: Associate Account Executive - Biopharma

A competitive compensation package, including unlimited commissions. You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and productivity. Opportunity to work in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration. Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language. Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills. Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar edisponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelasDelta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança dedados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções depipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz epropor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar comanalistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridadecom pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade deinvestigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration. Key Responsibilities Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation) Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes. Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes. Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations. Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools. Automation, Integration & AI Implementation Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.G., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript). Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks. Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software. IT Administration & Security Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365). Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl. Required Qualifications & Skills Technical Experience: 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.G., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols. Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies: Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving;
ability to identify theroot causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution;
capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions. Benefits & Compensation Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Solutions Architect
description: Job Title: Solutions Architect – Data Services Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Through December 2026 (Possibility of Extension) Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: EST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect – Data Services to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale data solutions for a global consulting environment. This role is responsible for defining end-to-end architectures across modern data platforms, ensuring alignment with business objectives, governance standards, and enterprise architecture principles. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Azure Databricks, data engineering, and cloud-native architectures, along with hands-on experience in data mesh, data products, and Unity Catalog–based governance. This is a hands-on architect role, requiring both strategic thinking and practical execution through proof-of-concepts (POCs) and close collaboration with engineering teams. Key Responsibilities Solution & Data Architecture Define and own solution-level architectures across data platforms, with a focus on Azure Databricks (workspaces, compute, orchestration). Design and implement data mesh architectures and domain-oriented data products. Establish governance frameworks using Unity Catalog, including security, lineage, and multi-workspace strategies. Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready data solutions. Identify cross-system dependencies, integration points, and architectural risks. Data Platform Design & Governance Define best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and serving within Databricks. Establish standards for data product ownership, contracts, and lifecycle management. Implement enterprise-grade security and access control using Unity Catalog, Entra ID, and cloud-native tools. Ensure alignment with enterprise governance, compliance, and security policies. Contribute to reusable architecture patterns and platform standards. Hands-on Execution & Proof-of-Concepts Design and execute POCs to validate architectural decisions and reduce delivery risk. Remain hands-on with: Python for data engineering, notebooks, and automation C# / Python for APIs, integrations, and platform services Support engineering teams by reviewing designs, resolving technical challenges, and ensuring architectural alignment. Collaboration & Delivery Alignment Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to shape features and solution direction. Collaborate with System Architects to align solution and system-level designs. Guide Agile teams through architecture decisions during planning and execution. Participate in architecture reviews and continuous improvement initiatives. Technical Leadership & Mentorship Provide guidance and mentorship to architects, tech leads, and senior engineers. Promote best practices in data architecture, engineering, and cloud platform design. Lead design reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Architecture Documentation Develop architecture artifacts including C4 models and design documentation. Create High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), including sequence diagrams and data flows. Document functional and non-functional requirements aligned with architectural designs. Required Qualifications 7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture roles. Proven experience designing and delivering data platforms on Azure Databricks. Strong understanding of data mesh concepts and domain-oriented data products. Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog (governance, security, lineage). Solid programming experience in Python and/or C#, including API and integration design. Experience designing end-to-end solutions across data platforms, APIs, and cloud infrastructure. Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, DevOps practices, and operational considerations. Experience creating architectural artifacts and design documentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to operate in complex environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements. Preferred Qualifications Prior experience as a Solutions Architect, System Architect, or Senior Technical Lead. Experience working in consulting or large enterprise environments. Familiarity with Agile frameworks (e.G., SAFe) and PI Planning. Experience with diagram-as-code tools such as Structurizr, PlantUML, or Mermaid. Key Competencies Strategic thinking with a hands-on, delivery-focused mindset Strong problem-solving and analytical skills Ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders Leadership and mentorship capabilities Continuous learning and innovation mindset

title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.G., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols. ability to identify theroot causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution;

Apple Platform Mastery: Deep familiarity with Apple HIG specifically for iPad, including expert use of split views, sidebars, popovers, and touch-target optimization. iOS 26 Familiarity: Working knowledge of the Liquid Glass design system, including navigation bars, sheets, and modal presentations under the new paradigm. Scientific UI Experience: Experience designing interfaces where data precision and reproducibility are prioritized;
prior work with medical, clinical, or industrial apps is a strong plus. title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines,regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimentoprático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimentoem Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description: About RateGain RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day. Exploring the role RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business. The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond. This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations. How your day will look like/Job responsibility Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.G. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs) Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends Education & Work Experience Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships Knowledge: In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors Skills: Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.) Attitude: Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment Equal Opportunity Employer We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to title: Solutions Architect
description: Job Title: Solutions Architect – Data Services Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration: Through December 2026 (Possibility of Extension) Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours: EST Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect – Data Services to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale data solutions for a global consulting environment. This role is responsible for defining end-to-end architectures across modern data platforms, ensuring alignment with business objectives, governance standards, and enterprise architecture principles. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Azure Databricks, data engineering, and cloud-native architectures, along with hands-on experience in data mesh, data products, and Unity Catalog–based governance. This is a hands-on architect role, requiring both strategic thinking and practical execution through proof-of-concepts (POCs) and close collaboration with engineering teams. Key Responsibilities Solution & Data Architecture Define and own solution-level architectures across data platforms, with a focus on Azure Databricks (workspaces, compute, orchestration). Design and implement data mesh architectures and domain-oriented data products. Establish governance frameworks using Unity Catalog, including security, lineage, and multi-workspace strategies. Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready data solutions. Identify cross-system dependencies, integration points, and architectural risks. Data Platform Design & Governance Define best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and serving within Databricks. Establish standards for data product ownership, contracts, and lifecycle management. Implement enterprise-grade security and access control using Unity Catalog, Entra ID, and cloud-native tools. Ensure alignment with enterprise governance, compliance, and security policies. Contribute to reusable architecture patterns and platform standards. Hands-on Execution & Proof-of-Concepts Design and execute POCs to validate architectural decisions and reduce delivery risk. Remain hands-on with: Python for data engineering, notebooks, and automation C# / Python for APIs, integrations, and platform services Support engineering teams by reviewing designs, resolving technical challenges, and ensuring architectural alignment. Collaboration & Delivery Alignment Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to shape features and solution direction. Collaborate with System Architects to align solution and system-level designs. Guide Agile teams through architecture decisions during planning and execution. Participate in architecture reviews and continuous improvement initiatives. Technical Leadership & Mentorship Provide guidance and mentorship to architects, tech leads, and senior engineers. Promote best practices in data architecture, engineering, and cloud platform design. Lead design reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Architecture Documentation Develop architecture artifacts including C4 models and design documentation. Create High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), including sequence diagrams and data flows. Document functional and non-functional requirements aligned with architectural designs. Required Qualifications 7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture roles. Proven experience designing and delivering data platforms on Azure Databricks. Strong understanding of data mesh concepts and domain-oriented data products. Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog (governance, security, lineage). Solid programming experience in Python and/or C#, including API and integration design. Experience designing end-to-end solutions across data platforms, APIs, and cloud infrastructure. Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, DevOps practices, and operational considerations. Experience creating architectural artifacts and design documentation. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to operate in complex environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements. Preferred Qualifications Prior experience as a Solutions Architect, System Architect, or Senior Technical Lead. Experience working in consulting or large enterprise environments. Familiarity with Agile frameworks (e.G., SAFe) and PI Planning. Experience with diagram-as-code tools such as Structurizr, PlantUML, or Mermaid. Key Competencies Strategic thinking with a hands-on, delivery-focused mindset Strong problem-solving and analytical skills Ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders Leadership and mentorship capabilities Continuous learning and innovation mindset

Skills: The candidate will contribute to the software development lifecycle of products and services from inception stage through to the final implementation. The candidate would be required to work closely with the developers & vendors to define, build and test the solution often working on multiple projects/work-streams at the same time. Work with Stakeholders during UAT to ensure reports meet requirements and ensure all deliveries are signed off. Education: Bachelor’s degree (B.A.) in Computer Science, MIS or related degree and a minimum of five (5) years of relevant development, testing or engineering experience or combination of education, training, and experience.

Perfil 2 – SAP Scrum Master – Ariba Buying Channel & S/4HANA Integration✦ Principais ResponsabilidadesAtuar como Scrum Master em times SAP focados em SAP Ariba Buying / Guided Buying.Orquestrar Buying Channels (Guided Buying, Catálogos, Spot Buy), regras de aprovação e políticas de compra.Coordenar integrações entre SAP Ariba e SAP S/4HANA, incluindo fluxos de compras, faturamento, impostos, fornecedores e contabilidade.Facilitar cerimônias Agile, remover impedimentos e garantir previsibilidade das entregas.Trabalhar de forma próxima com áreas como Procurement, Finance, Tax, IT Security, Master Data e fornecedores externos.Assegurar aderência a SOX, GxP e requisitos de auditoria, especialmente em ambientes corporativos regulados.Apoiar fases de hypercare, estabilização, planejamento de releases e melhoria contínua.✦ Requisitos EsperadosInglês fluenteExperiência como Scrum Master em projetos SAP, com atuação em Ariba.Conhecimento sólido de processos Source-to-Pay / Procure-to-Pay.Vivência com SAP Ariba Buying / Guided Buying, catálogos e workflows de aprovação.Entendimento de integrações Ariba–S/4HANA (CPI, APIs, IDocs).Experiência em ambientes corporativos globais, complexos ou regulados.Certificações Agile (CSM, PSM, SAFe) são diferenciais.

title: System Architect
description: Project Description: Owns the end-to-end vision and AI architecture for consumer devices. Defines scalable, power-efficient, and production-ready imaging and perception systems across product lines. Drives technical direction across sensor, ISP, CV, ML, and platform integration. Responsibilities: Define and own end-to-end vision system architecture (sensor → ISP → CV/ML → application layer). Translate product and UX requirements into scalable technical solutions. Define image quality strategy aligned with AI and user experience goals. Architect reusable, modular CV/ML frameworks across multiple product SKUs. Drive system-level trade-offs across performance, power, cost, and thermal limits. Define AI model lifecycle strategy from training to OTA deployment. Architect heterogeneous compute utilization (CPU/GPU/NPU/DSP). Define system KPIs: latency, FPS, power, memory, boot time, and robustness. Lead technology selection for inference engines, frameworks, and hardware platforms. Guide SoC bring-up and performance validation for vision pipelines. Establish coding standards, modularization strategy, and long-term maintainability. Identify technical risks early and define mitigation strategies. Collaborate with hardware, ISP, Android/Linux platform, and product teams. Mentor senior engineers and provide architectural governance. Contribute to long-term vision/AI roadmap across product generations. Mandatory Skills Description: - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (PhD preferred). 10-15+ years of experience in imaging/vision/perception systems. Proven experience architecting and shipping multiple consumer products with vision/AI. Deep understanding of imaging pipeline (sensor behavior, ISP, tuning impact). Strong embedded system architecture experience. Expert-level C++ and system-level optimization knowledge. Strong expertise in CV and ML system integration. Experience deploying optimized ML models on consumer SoCs. Experience with heterogeneous compute architectures. Experience defining system-level KPIs and validation strategies. Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills. Languages: English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Desenvolvedor Back End Java
description: Back End Java Developer Description The ideal candidate for this role will have at least four years of experience building Java applications, most recently within a microservices architecture. Preferably, you will have a strong understanding of DevOps and deployment procedures within an AWS environment. However, any experience with containerization and continuous integration would be beneficial. Streaming protocols for VOD and live streaming technologies are bonus points! The candidate will have a strong understanding and experience building Rest APIs, streaming protocols, and Microservices, often integrating with third-party software. They primarily focus on streaming solutions, digital security, and automation, working with Java 11, Spring Boot, AWS Lambdas, Docker, and CI/CD. This is an opportunity to grow into a Lead or Principal engineer while working on some of the most complex solutions for the media and entertainment business. Preferred Technical Skills for reference - Programming: Languages Java, Python - Operating systems: Linux, Windows 10, Mac OS - Development Tools: Intellij Idea, VS Code, Vim - Networking: REST, MQTT, gRPC, XMPP - Technologies: Spring, Spring Boot, JPA, Liquibase, Querydsl, PostgresSQL, Redis, Hadoop, HBase, Apache Phoenix, Apache Spark, AWS SDK, Maven, Gradle, Git, Docker - English Advance

title: Ai Trainer
description: We are looking for motivated individuals residing in Brazil to join our team as Freelance AI Trainers. This is an entry-level opportunity perfect for undergraduate students and freshers who are native Portuguese speakers and eager to contribute to the development of next-generation artificial intelligence. Role Overview As an AI Trainer, you will help improve the accuracy and quality of AI models by reviewing, labeling, and generating text-based content. Your insights as a native speaker are essential to ensuring the AI understands the nuances of the Portuguese language and Brazilian culture. Key Responsibilities Data Labeling: Categorize and annotate text data to help the AI understand context and intent. Content Evaluation: Review AI-generated responses for accuracy, tone, and grammatical correctness. Writing & Rewriting: Create high-quality sample dialogues or prompts in native Portuguese. Fact-Checking: Verify information to ensure the AI provides reliable and safe responses. Requirements Language: Native-level proficiency in Portuguese (written and verbal). Location: Must be a current resident of Brazil. Education: Currently enrolled in an undergraduate program or a recent graduate (Freshers are encouraged to apply!). Skills: Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and the ability to follow complex guidelines. Tech Savvy: Comfortable working with online platforms and basic productivity tools. Equipment: Access to a reliable computer and high-speed internet. Compensation & Benefits Rate: $4 USD per hour. Flexibility: Work from anywhere in Brazil with a schedule that fits your studies or other commitments. Experience: Gain hands-on experience in the rapidly growing field of Artificial Intelligence.

title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
description: Project Description: We are seeking an experienced Senior C# Developer to join a collaborative engineering team focused on enhancing Portfolio Management capabilities. This role will partner closely with engineering, trading, risk, and operations teams to design and deliver scalable, high-performance solutions that improve portfolio transparency, accuracy, and operational efficiency across the firm. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in C#/.NET with a deep understanding of portfolio and position management concepts, and an interest in modern development practices including AI-enabled engineering and specification-driven development. Responsibilities: - Portfolio Management Enhancement Partner with cross-functional teams to improve and extend portfolio management capabilities Enhance portfolio aggregation, exposure calculation, and P&L reporting functionality Improve intraday and end-of-day position workflows and controls Contribute to strategic initiatives modernizing portfolio and position infrastructure - Core Development Design, develop, and maintain high-performance services in C# / .NET Contribute to the evolution of the Position Service architecture Develop and enhance functionality within the Portfolio Management platform Build scalable, resilient microservices supporting portfolio and order management workflows Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following engineering best practices - AI & Intelligent Systems Identify opportunities to leverage AI/ML and automation to enhance portfolio analytics, reconciliation, monitoring, and operational workflows Collaborate on integrating AI-driven tools into the development lifecycle (e.G., intelligent code generation, review, testing, and documentation) Contribute to the design of systems that enable advanced analytics and data-driven insights - Specification-Driven Development Promote and apply specification-driven development practices, including clear technical design documents and formalized functional requirements Translate business requirements into precise system specifications prior to implementation Ensure alignment between architecture, documentation, and delivered functionality Improve development velocity and quality through stronger upfront design and validation processes - System Design & Optimization Improve system performance, scalability, and reliability Optimize data processing pipelines and database interactions Design and maintain robust APIs for internal consumers Support both real-time and batch processing requirements - Collaboration & Leadership Work closely with portfolio managers, traders, risk, and operations teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions Collaborate within the engineering team to drive architectural improvements Participate in code reviews and mentor junior developers Promote best practices in testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and observability Mandatory Skills Description: 7+ years of professional software development experience. Strong expertise in C# and .NET (Core/Framework). Experience building distributed systems and service-oriented architectures. Full lifecycle experience including requirements gathering, implementation, testing, release, and support. Strong SQL and database design experience. Experience with messaging systems and asynchronous programming. Independent mindset, passion for technology, and an appetite for taking ownership, learning new technologies, and building innovative products. Experience in Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP) experience involving stateless and serverless solutions, and cost optimization Exposure to multi-threaded programming concepts. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong team player. Bachelor's degree in computer science or engineering. English: C1 Advanced

title: Vaga  professor(a) de pedagogia (projetos educacionais)
description:
Professor(a) Projetos EducacionaisSobre a SD Student Travel

A SD Student Travel é especializada em experiências educacionais que complementam o aprendizado escolar. Nosso trabalho não é turismo: é ajudar escolas a levarem o mundo para dentro da educação, formando alunos mais maduros, autônomos e preparados para o futuro.

Sobre a Vaga

Você é professor e sente que sua capacidade vai além da sala de aula? Esta posição é ideal para quem deseja ampliar sua atuação profissional, participando de projetos estratégicos, reuniões com gestores e apresentações pedagógicas.

Aqui, você continua no universo da educação, mas com maior exposição, relacionamento institucional e novas possibilidades de crescimento profissional e financeiro. Não é sobre sair da educação, é sobre impactá-la de outra forma.

O que você vai fazer

  • Representar a SD em reuniões com escolas, coordenadores e diretores;

  • Apresentar projetos educacionais e iniciativas pedagógicas inovadoras;

  • Desenvolver e manter o relacionamento com diferentes instituições de ensino;

  • Apoiar a mobilização de professores embaixadores, alunos e famílias;

  • Contribuir com a expansão de projetos e participação em eventos do setor.

Como será sua rotina

  • Agenda ativa de visitas e reuniões (presenciais e online);

  • Contato frequente com gestores educacionais;

  • Momentos de planejamento interno e participação em encontros do setor.

Perfil que buscamos

  • Formação: Licenciatura completa 

  • Experiência: Vivência no ambiente escolar;

  • Comunicação: Excelente oratória e facilidade para falar em público;

  • Perfil Relacional: Gosto por networking e conforto em lidar com cargos de gestão;

  • Atitude: Proatividade, organização com prazos e ambição para crescer na carreira.

Requisitos e Disponibilidade

  • Disponibilidade mínima de 3 dias úteis por semana (cenário ideal: 4 dias);

  • Modelo Híbrido (presença frequente em escolas).

  • Aceitamos profissionais em diferentes momentos: com carga reduzida em escolas ou professores experientes/aposentados com energia para novos desafios.

O que oferecemos

  • Tipo de Contrato: CLT;

  • Fixo: R$ 3.000,00 + Remuneração Variável; 

  • Crescimento: Plano de carreira para posições estratégicas de maior escala.

 Esta vaga é para você se:

  • Você quer aumentar sua renda sem abandonar a área da educação;

  • Busca maior reconhecimento e autonomia profissional;

  • Tem energia para uma rotina dinâmica e fora da sala de aula tradicional.
